mission_process: Guided solar observation session at the Observatório do Lago Alqueva (OLA) in Monsaraz.
During the session, the solar chromosphere, solar prominences, solar explosions and the broader dynamics of the Sun and other stars were explained.
After the visit, Frederico Arez shared two solar chromosphere images by email, including the image acquired on the day of observation and an additional image from 19/08/2025.
conclusion: This mission records a foundational solar observation experience that predates the formal creation of the Home Space Observatory project.
It is included as a reference mission because it contributed directly to the project’s scientific and observational inspiration.
notes: Images courtesy of Frederico Arez. Observation session took place around 17:00.
